# goslop text fixture — CWE-93 helper returning a formatted value (vulnerable)
lang: python
file: CWE-93-numeric-call-vulnerable.py
---
def _trace_header(request_id: str, user_input: str) -> str:
    return f"{request_id}:{user_input}"


def trace(response, request_id: str, user_input: str) -> None:
    response.headers["X-Trace"] = _trace_header(request_id, user_input)
